itemGroup.northeast_china_delight.blocks: Northeast China Delight: Blocks & Building Materials
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.ginseng: Wild ginseng grows in cold biomes, and wandering traders sell it; ginseng seeds can be found in structure chests. Plant the seeds near snow in a cold biome, and dig the mature plant with an empty hand for ginseng and seeds.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.wood_ea: Wild wood ears grow on oak, birch and dark oak trunks. Right-click the side of a bark-covered log of the same wood with a wood ear to plant it, and right-click to harvest once grown.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.hazel_m: Generates near hazelnut bushes and broadleaf trees; can be planted into a Hazel Mushroom Colony.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.hairtai: Caught in a Deep Cold Ocean or Deep Frozen Ocean with 150 blocks of open water and depth of at least 20 blocks.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.oyster: Caught by fishing where a river meets an ocean.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.sea_cuc: Caught in a Deep Cold Ocean or Deep Frozen Ocean with 150 blocks of open water and depth of at least 20 blocks.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.salt: Cook a Water Basin in a Cooking Pot.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.pig_off: Pigs killed with a knife have a chance to drop these, at most two kinds per kill; a burning pig drops smoked hock and liver instead.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.frozen_: Frozen Pears are sold by farmers, and Canned Yellow Peaches by the Side Dish Merchant.
With Fruits Delight installed, they can also be made from its pears and peaches.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.bellflo: Grows sparsely at Forest, Birch Forest and Taiga edges, in Flower Forests, and on Meadows or Plains near Forests.
item.northeast_china_delight.sauerkraut_: Pork Rib Stew with Sour Cabbage
item.northeast_china_delight.cured_pork_: Cured Pork Stew with Green Beans
block.northeast_china_delight.cured_pork: Cured Pork Stew with Green Beans
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.door_cu: Craft a Door Curtain from sticks and wool. Put it in the banner slot of a Loom and dye it blue for a Cotton Door Curtain, red for a Floral Door Curtain or green for an Army Green Door Curtain.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.paper_c: Hold Red Paper and Shears in your two hands to make a paper-cut. There are round and corner paper-cuts, which can be stuck on Paper Lattice Windows.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.big_sto: Place stoves in a 2×2 square to form a Big Stove, then place a Big Iron Pot on it to cook big pot dishes. A pot recipe usually consists of water, ingredients and seasonings; put the lid on once everything is in to start cooking.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.big_pot: The lid speeds up big pot cooking, and can also serve as a lesser shield.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.northea: Equip all four pieces of this set and you'll feel power surging through you!
jei.northeast_china_delight.big_pot.liqu: No liquid allowed in the pot
jei.northeast_china_delight.big_pot.cont: Container to serve with, one per serving
No more room in the pot
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.hand_pu: Right-click with an empty bucket, Large Basin or glass bottle to get water; it never runs out. Empty-handed, pours water into a cauldron, vat, Create Basin or Item Drain in front. It cannot pump water in the Nether.
jei.northeast_china_delight.info.mystery: When the ingredients in a Big Iron Pot match no recipe, cooking yields Suspicious Stew. Its effects depend on the kinds and amounts of ingredients, and seasonings extend them.

item.northeast_china_delight.music_disc_: The Great Northeast Is Mine Own Native Land
jukebox_song.northeast_china_delight.nor: The Great Northeast Is Mine Own Native Land
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.0: Wind sweeps o'er wheat-waves; sweet the rice-bloom blows;
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.1: Black earth it nursed our parents, whence our blood flows.
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.2: Each winter-tide flies down the great snow, white;
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.3: On the warm kang, of home we talk all night.
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.4: In blue heavens drift the white clouds and stray;
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.5: Murmuring flows the limpid brook away.
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.7: Twists the yangge; the folk are glad and bright.
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.8: The Great Northeast is mine own native land,
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.9: Where the suona bloweth a beauty grand.
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.10: When brothers meet, a cup or twain we drain;
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.11: It warmeth my heart; drunk, the moon doth reign.
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.12: The Great Northeast is mine own native land,
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.13: In this same spot, born and bred, here I stand.
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.14: The heart of the Northeast, the Northeast's love;
lyrics.northeast_china_delight.15: I love thee passing well, O native land!
